kpte01.title: Cancer, you're not too much
kpte01.caption: If you've ever said sorry for a long voice note, this one's for you. Your feelings aren't a burden, and the right people ask follow-up questions.

kpte02.title: Virgo, about that unanswered text
kpte02.caption: Rereading your own text for the tenth time? You said it kindly, so your part is done. One quiet phone is not a verdict on you. Go live your evening.

kpte03.title: Aries, you shot your shot
kpte03.caption: They said no, and it stings. A no is information, not a judgement on who you are. Asking was brave, and brave is the win. Send this to the friend who just asked.

kpte04.title: Taurus, step away from the old photos
kpte04.caption: 2 a.m., the old album, the ache. Missing them doesn't mean you should go back. It means it mattered, and that's allowed. Now water, sleep, and breakfast tomorrow.

kpte05.title: Gemini, close some tabs
kpte05.caption: First-date nerves the night before? You don't need a script. Curiosity is your best outfit, so bring one real question and let the rest of the tabs close.

kpte06.title: Leo, you shine with no applause
kpte06.caption: Feeling invisible to your crush hurts. You don't have to perform to matter, and the right person notices the quiet you too. Notice yourself first.

kpte07.title: Libra, a kind no is allowed
kpte07.caption: Saying yes to a date you don't want helps no one. 'No, thank you' is a full sentence, and kind and honest fit in one text. Save this for the next invite.

kpte08.title: Scorpio, say the soft thing
kpte08.caption: Typed 'I like you', deleted it, sent 'lol'? Walls keep out the right people too. Soft isn't weak, it's brave. Say it once, plainly.

kpte09.title: Sagittarius, unpack the suitcase
kpte09.caption: Liking someone and wanting to run at the same time is so human. Liking someone isn't a cage. Tell them you're a little scared; honesty makes room to stay.

kpte10.title: Capricorn, close the laptop
kpte10.caption: Cancelling plans for 'one more email' again? Rest isn't a prize you have to earn, and you're wanted, not just useful. Say yes to one slow evening this week.

kpte11.title: Aquarius, your weird is the point
kpte11.caption: Ever felt like nobody gets you? Don't sand yourself down to fit a room. Your people are out there being weird too, so go where your weird is welcome.

kpte12.title: Pisces, keep some for you
kpte12.caption: For the friend who gives everyone everything: your big heart isn't the problem. It just lives in you too. Keep one piece for yourself tonight.

kpte13.title: Taurus, you are not behind
kpte13.caption: Everyone's getting engaged and you feel late? There's no deadline on love, and their timeline isn't your scoreboard. Build a life you love in the meantime.

kpte14.title: Virgo, take your own advice
kpte14.caption: You'd never let your best friend settle, so don't let yourself. Talk to you the way you talk to them. Tag the friend who gives advice and never takes it.

kpte15.title: Gemini, you deserve a definitely
kpte15.caption: Stuck on 'we'll see'? That isn't an answer. Ask once, clearly, then believe what they tell you. You're allowed to want something sure.

kpte16.title: The full pep talk: the 2 a.m. breakup call
kpte16.caption: The 2 a.m. call after a breakup, start to finish. Breaking up isn't failing; it's two people being honest. Stay for the last line, and send it to whoever needs it tonight.

kpte17.title: The full pep talk: your crush said no
kpte17.caption: They said no, and the replay won't stop. A no to dating isn't a no to you, and the proof of who you are doesn't depend on one answer. The last line, though.

kpte18.title: The full pep talk: home alone for the holidays
kpte18.caption: Alone on the 24th and telling everyone you're fine? Lonely isn't a flaw; it's a signal to reach for your people. Someone has a seat saved for you.

kpte19.title: The full pep talk: you got ghosted
kpte19.caption: Three days of grey ticks after a great date. Their silence is about their skills, not your worth. One kind closing text, then phone down. You can make your own closure.

kpte20.title: The full pep talk: scared to try again
kpte20.caption: Someone nice asked you out and every old hurt showed up first. The new person isn't the old one. Not forever, just one coffee. Wait for the last line.
